outcome.start: pi-env exited with code 1 before it was ready

argv: sh -c 'echo PI-ENV-PROBE; uname -s; uname -m; uname -o 2>/dev/null || echo -; printf "%s\n" "$HOME" "${TMPDIR:--}" "${LD_PRELOAD:--}"'

sh -c 'hash() { if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1; elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1; elif command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then openssl dgst -sha256 "$1" | sed '\''s/.*= //'\''; else echo none; fi; }; f='\''/home/me/.pi/mobile/tools/pi-env-aa0eb3a5daa09fd7d583aa6330d98521'\''; if [ -f "$f" ] && [ "$(hash "$f")" = aa0eb3a5daa09fd7d583aa6330d985217d180b858c97dab3ef247ebe8dfe8cc7 ]; then echo present; elif [ "$(hash /dev/null)" = none ]; then echo nohash; else echo missing; fi'

sh -c 'set -e
hash() { if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1; elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1; elif command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then openssl dgst -sha256 "$1" | sed '\''s/.*= //'\''; else echo none; fi; }
f='\''/home/me/.pi/mobile/tools/pi-env-aa0eb3a5daa09fd7d583aa6330d98521'\''
d=$(dirname "$f")
mkdir -p "$d"
chmod 700 "$d"
t=$(mktemp "$d/.pi-env.XXXXXX")
cat > "$t"
if [ "$(hash "$t")" != aa0eb3a5daa09fd7d583aa6330d985217d180b858c97dab3ef247ebe8dfe8cc7 ]; then rm -f "$t"; echo "pi-env upload is corrupt" >&2; exit 1; fi
chmod 700 "$t"
mv -f "$t" "$f"
for old in "$d"/pi-env-*; do [ "$old" = "$f" ] || rm -f "$old"; done
echo deployed'
